notes.title: August 2019 Patch Update
notes.notes:
A new update has been released for Sword Art Online: Fatal Bullet. You can find here all the information regarding the changes, adjustments and new content:

[h1]Maximum Level 285 → 300[/h1]

[h1]3 new high-difficulty quests added to online co-op[/h1]

[list]
[*]     LV300 HC Co-op: Special Challenge α
[*]     LV300 HC Co-op: Special Challenge β
[*]     LV300 HC Co-op: Special Challenge γ
[/list]

[h1]6 new costumes added to Lobby[/h1]

[list]
[*]     Alice in her childhood costume (Maid clothes)
[*]     Military Waitress
[*]     Alice in her childhood costume (Maid clothes/Variation)
[*]     Military Waitress (Variation)
[*]     Daybreak Lawson Coat F
[*]     Nocturnal Lawson Coat M
[/list]

[h1]5 new accessories added[/h1] (also available at the accessory trader)

[list]
[*]     Alice Childhood Headband
[*]     Military Waitress Hat
[*]     Katamari Damacy
[*]     Pooka from DIGDUG
[*]     PAC-MAN
[/list]

[h1]1 new painting added to Avatar Customization[/h1]

    [list]
[*] Genpei Toma Den face Painting
[/list]

[h1]Added “Grand Master Class” to BoB Simulation[/h1]

[list]
[*]     Unable to play the quest without installation of DLC1 which includes BoB simulation.
[*]     Rank 11 weapons drop (The DLC's original ones do not drop)
[*]     Weapons which would be more Epic drop
[*]     Preliminaries participants is 8 includes players.
[*]     Finals participants is 16 includes players ←would decrease if its processing load is hard
[*]     Shiki and Lievre join the quest
[/list]

[h1]Added total bounty rewards[/h1]

[list]
[*] Total bounty rewards are set from 140000000 to 160000000
[/list]

[h1]New rank11 weapons「Series Type-Z」available in new HC Co-op[/h1]

[list]
[*]     AMR Tiamat Type-Z
[*]     SPB Rapier Type-Z
[*]     SPB Potassium Type-Z
[*]     Valkyrie Type-Z
[/list]

[h1]"Release weapons potential ability" has been added to Lisbeth's Workshop[/h1]

Enable to make the weapons individual power value limit strong from by 5% to by 10 % voluntarily, which is required both new item "Release potential ability IC" and credit.

[h1]Online battle hero adjustments[/h1]

[h1]Several bugs fixed[/h1]

notes.title: Sword Art Online: Fatal Bullet - April 2019 Patch Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31713285/2bfb2088dc85dfcd0e6ee20d05f4af9dd592feab.png[/img]

A new update is coming to Sword Art Online: Fatal Bullet today, April 18th. You can find here all the important information regarding the changes, adjustments and new content: 

[h1]Maximum Level 275 → 285[/h1]

[h1]3 new high-difficulty quests added to online co-op:[/h1]
[list]
[*] LV285 HC Co-op: Special Invitation α
[*] LV285 HC Co-op: Special Invitation β
[*] LV285 HC Co-op: Special Invitation γ
[/list]

[h1]3 new costumes added to Lobby[/h1]
[list]
[*] Heart of a Smith F (Anime GGO Lisbeth Costume) along with a variation
[*] Tamer Suit F (Anime GGO Silica Costume) along with a variation
[*] Howling Wolf M (Anime GGO Klein Costume) along with a variation
[/list]

[h1]3 new accessories added (also available at the accessory trader)[/h1]
[list]
[*] CSS Beret (Anime GGO Lisbeth Hat)
[*] Soldier Goggles (Anime GGO Klein Hat)
[*] Senior Officer Cap (Officer Cap [variation] [unisex])
[/list]

[h1]Added total bounty rewards[/h1]
[list]
[*] Total bounty rewards are set from 120000000 to 140000000
[*] Accessories (Legendary) and rank 11 weapons (both come with the special effect) are available. The effect level of the accessories or weapons will be set to the maximum.
[/list]

[h1]New rank11 weapons「Series Type-Z」available in new HC Co-op[/h1]
[list]
[*] Long Stroke Type-Z
[*] Kagemitsu G9 Type-Z
[*] Pandemonium Type-Z
[*] Deneb Kaitos Type-Z
[/list]

[h1]Adjustments for more than rank 9 weapons[/h1]
[list]
[*] Sword and Sword&Gun: critical rate up by 5%
[*] HG Kuroneko: adjusted strength since it was relatively inferior to the other weapons.
[*] Crimson Roar: adjusted strength since it was relatively inferior to the other weapons.
[/list]

[h1]Added events available to be viewed on the bed[/h1]
[list]
[*] Yui
[*] Itsuki
[/list]

[h1]Added option to choose multiple materials for weapon transformations [/h1]

[h1]Increased the limit of item storage and item Box. The limits will increase as follows: [/h1]
[list]
[*] Item storage 400→ 500
[*] Item box 700 → 800
[/list]

[h1]Online battle hero adjustments[/h1]

[h1]Several bugs fixed[/h1]

notes.title: Patch Note 11th March 2018
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31713285/7ade33574ad597d9b72ebe6f11bd25187143fc79.jpg[/img]A patch has been pushed lately to fix some issues on SWORD ART ONLINE: FATAL BULLET and we hope it has improved your experience with the game. We are also investigating more bugs to fix them soon.

Thanks for playing Sword Art Online: Fatal Bullet

List of changes:[list]
[*]Fixed issue with the game going back to the title screen after changing the setting in the “ADVANCE OPTION”.
[*]Improved stability when using Ultra Wide Monitor.
[*]Adjusted balance with online matching.
[*]Ability to acquire items after defeating enemies in Online co-op quest.
[*]Fixed issue with proceeding past loading screen.[/list]
